messages:
aj: Running the new 3-bit quant experiment across the eval harness and hit a wall — runner jobs start, then throughput drops to zero and tasks pile up in queue.
samir: Can you paste the runner logs? Sounds like worker starvation rather than a model bug.
maria: saw something similar last month when we enabled the KV-cache prefetcher. autoscaler didn't spawn new workers for some shards.
aj: log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:05:12Z INFO shard=13 task=eval queued
2026-03-18T14:05:25Z WARN shard=13 worker-pool idle_count=0 busy_count=0
2026-03-18T14:05:37Z ERROR shard=13 lease-acquire timeout=30s
```
aj: weirdly busy_count=0 while queued grows. no obvious OOM.
kelly: @aj is this on CI or a local cluster? CI runs smaller pool, so starvation plausible.
aj: both — repro'd on local 4-GPU staging and CI eval job. CI job failed: /ci/pipelines/5324
ci-bot: Pipeline 5324: failed after 45m — step "eval-harness/shard-run" exited 1. Logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood/p/5324/logs
samir: hypothesis: quantized model increases per-request decoding latency (more kernel retries), lowering throughput and blocking the fixed worker pool. Need to adjust queue/backpressure config: max-inflight-per-worker, per-shard concurrency, and lease timeouts.
maria: also remember the older autoscaler uses cpu-based heuristics; for GPU heavy evals it won't trigger fast enough. ops-bot: autoscaler event stream:
```
2026-03-18T14:07:00Z scale_down_attempt shard=13 reason=idle
2026-03-18T14:09:10Z scale_up_request shard=13 requested=2 granted=0
```
maria: scale_up_request was denied due to quota. That matches the CI failure.
kelly: action items: 1) add a CI-only backpressure flag to lower parallelism for quant experiments, 2) add a test asserting worker-pool doesn't hit idle_count=0 while queue>0, 3) make autoscaler consider gpu_load metric.
aj: I can open the PR for the CI flag and the test. Will add a synthetic load test that simulates longer decode times.
samir: also add a metric to the eval-runner: `worker_pool_block_time_seconds` and expose it to dashboards. will wire alerts if > 30s.
kelly: good. Please include a small repro script in the PR so QA can run locally.
aj: PR incoming — draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/289
ci-bot: PR 289: opened by aj. Labels: [ci, infra, high-priority]
maria: for longer term, we should look at dynamic per-shard queues and allow burst leasing from other pools during heavy quant runs.
samir: agreed. I'm going to prototype a lease-stealing patch this week.
kelly: can someone file a short postmortem once PRs land so product teams know the risk when onboarding quant models? small doc is fine.
aj: will do. I'll include notes on recommended CI flags for model bring-up, and a snippet for prometheus alerts.
ops-bot: Note: quota_request_team=eng-ml ticket created (Q-1721) to increase staging GPU quota temporarily.
samir: thanks. keep updates in this thread and ping #eng-oncall if CI starts failing again. :thumbsup:
